limitations: One sequential 32-request arm each in the same service; not repeated/interleaved trials.
Physical card 6 control is primary; historical card-7 throughput is context only.
Profiler durations are separate from unprofiled throughput.

baseline.sql:
WITH compute_view AS (
    SELECT c.globalTaskId, ROUND(t.endNs - t.startNs) AS duration_ns, n.value AS op_name, type_str.value AS op_type
    FROM COMPUTE_TASK_INFO c
    LEFT JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId = c.globalTaskId
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id = c.name
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS type_str ON type_str.id = c.opType
)
SELECT op_name, op_type, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(duration_ns) AS total_ns
FROM compute_view GROUP BY op_name, op_type ORDER BY total_ns DESC LIMIT 20;
baseline.decode_sql:
WITH compute_view AS (
    SELECT c.globalTaskId, ROUND(t.endNs - t.startNs) AS duration_ns, n.value AS op_name, type_str.value AS op_type
    FROM COMPUTE_TASK_INFO c
    LEFT JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId = c.globalTaskId
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id = c.name
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS type_str ON type_str.id = c.opType
)
SELECT op_name, op_type, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(duration_ns) AS total_ns
FROM (SELECT * FROM compute_view LIMIT -1)
WHERE globalTaskId IN (SELECT globalTaskId FROM TASK WHERE startNs >= ?)
GROUP BY op_name, op_type ORDER BY total_ns DESC LIMIT 20;
baseline.host_scope_note: CPU wall scopes are nested and asynchronous with device work; never add them to GPU task totals or label synchronization time as CPU computation.

profiling.method: Decode begins at the first captured main-model MODEL_EXECUTE; prompt/eager work before it is excluded. Native attention projections identify the main model ID. Custom kernels have sentinel Model ID, so graph membership is reconstructed from MODEL_EXECUTE boundaries and the native graph endpoints, never from the custom Model ID. Window ends at last compute task. CPU API durations are never added to device time.
limits: Profiler timings are instrumented, not new unprofiled throughput results.
Pipeline activity is not peak bandwidth utilization.
No-compute intervals may contain DMA, synchronization or host work.
Kernel totals include overlaps; exclusive window categories are reported separately.
A short single-concurrency sample does not establish all batch/context workloads.

notes: CPU self wall time includes scheduling/GC/profiler and uninstrumented code, not necessarily busy computation.
Flow phase attribution identifies who launches the next task, not by itself the cause of the delay.
Same-service scheduling A/B; profiling overhead is separate from unprofiled throughput.
